entities.summary: Fritz Todt was a German construction engineer and senior political figure of the Nazi Party. In 1938, he founded Organisation Todt (OT), a military-engineering organisation that supplied German industry with forced labour, and he served as Reich Minister for Armaments and Ammunition in Nazi Germany early in World War II, directing the entire German wartime military economy from that position.
